item.description:
Aki 0.12.1

Fixed

  • A page's menu that opens on hover (a site's top menu) stays on screen when marking opens, so you can mark it.
  • Sessions in an Orca tab opened recently show the name you gave the tab again (sidebar, History and marks), not the title the agent set.

item.title: 0.12.1-beta.2
item.description:
Aki 0.12.1-beta.2

Fixed

  • Sessions in an Orca tab opened recently show the name you gave the tab again (sidebar, History and marks), not the title the agent set.
  • A page's menu that opens on hover stays on screen when marking opens, so you can mark it.

Aki 0.12.0

Changed

  • Marking opens like the Mac's ⌘⇧4, at once: the pin and a thin orange frame, and the screen stays live, not dimmed. With "Freeze the screen" on, or a menu open, it's a picture.
  • Marking opens light: nothing outlined. Drag an area or click a point. Press E to outline the elements under the pointer, and E again to go back. To always open with elements outlined, as before: Settings → Marking → "Under the pointer".

Fixed

  • The pointer no longer blinks to the arrow or a hand as marking opens, and the screen doesn't hitch as you let go of the shortcut.
  • A session working in a folder inside the one its Orca tab opened in is linked to its tab again: it shows the name you gave the tab, and marks are typed into it.
  • Marking can't get stuck "opening" when the Mac's screen capture doesn't answer.

Aki 0.11.1

Fixed

  • History takes the keys as soon as it opens, so esc closes it without clicking it first.
  • A mark on a localhost page goes to the right session again when a second copy of Chrome is open (a test one, another profile folder): Aki now reads only your window, by its title and place on screen.
